messages.subject: gl.filter.heterozygosity -- serious bug
parts:
Hi. Not sure how many of you are or have used gl.filter.heterozygosty, but a bug was brought to our attention by Gabrielle. We have now fixed this.

The gl.report.heterozygosity function works fine.

Not sure how many people have used this filter function, as applications are few, but if you have used it, you should check if the outcome of the bug affected your results.

The revised version will be posted to the developmental site /dev shortly, and you can pull the latest beta version (/dev) from there to get the latest fixes. Instructions as prior.

We have been asked if the /dev version should be the version of choice. As a general rule, you should use the CRAN version of dartR. Using the /dev version exposes you to all the new features under development, but also exposes you to the risk that the /dev version has not been fully tested.  Your call.

A
